plugins.name: credit-360
plugins.description: Credit 360 is a relationship-level commercial-credit cockpit for C&I bankers: a worklist-first React artifact, opened from Cowork chat and driven in plain language, over the Salesforce-hosted Customer360 MCP data plane (28 tools: 10 reads, 8 governed stage/execute write pairs, a second-hop completion tool and one stage-only renewal, per-user OAuth). It needs six claude.ai connectors added by name, five of them required. Needs-action queue, activity audit trail, covenant effective-challenge, page-agnostic AI chat, data-gated Client Actions, and guided workflows for client-request-to-action, package-scoped covenant review, collateral valuation and relationship actions. Every write stages first, shows the org's warnings verbatim, and executes only on a named human's confirmation.
